question: Can the already-frozen regime/loop forecasts be translated into positive hypothetical stock-only P&L under a causal, fixed execution rule and explicit friction sensitivity?

interpretation.known_constraint: The retained forecast predicts movement magnitude and range, not direction. Therefore direct directional P&L is a falsification and the primary translation obtains direction only after a causal future breakout trigger.

frozen_inputs.provider_price_basis: provider OHLC exactly as stored; no independent split/dividend adjustment is added by this test
frozen_inputs.later_period_interpretation: 2025 is development and 2023 is backward portability; neither can establish prospective profitability.

thresholds.source: reconstruct each representation's frozen 2024 fitted future-range prediction at every 2024 training anchor with the same exact horizon support and bar-53 cutoff as scoring

directional_falsification.direction: long when the matching frozen direction probability is at least 0.5; short otherwise
directional_falsification.gated_variants: require matching frozen predicted future range at or above its 2024 P75 threshold
directional_falsification.entry: next regular-session bar open after the completed anchor bar
directional_falsification.reason: Direction was already rejected on proper losses and AUC; these cells only measure the economic consequence of that failure.

causal_breakout.gate: all anchors for breakout_all; matching 2024-P75 predicted-range gate for representation variants
causal_breakout.trigger_operators: upper high >= trigger; lower low <= trigger
causal_breakout.activation: begin with the next bar and remain armed through the horizon exit bar
causal_breakout.direction: first exclusive upper trigger is long; first exclusive lower trigger is short
causal_breakout.gap_fill: long fills at max(upper trigger, triggering-bar open); short fills at min(lower trigger, triggering-bar open)
causal_breakout.open_ordering: if the triggering bar opens at or beyond exactly one trigger, that open establishes the first side even if the later bar range touches both
causal_breakout.same_bar_both_triggers: when neither side is established at the open and both triggers are touched in the first event bar, cancel the signal permanently as path ambiguous

overlap_and_portfolio.overlap_recomputed_within: each strategy by horizon cell independently
overlap_and_portfolio.greedy_rule: accept the earliest qualifying anchor; reject later anchors whose completed-bar ordinal is strictly below accepted_anchor_ordinal + horizon, even when a breakout never triggers
overlap_and_portfolio.window_convention: the armed window ends at accepted_anchor_ordinal + horizon close; a new signal formed at that same close may arm for the following bar
overlap_and_portfolio.cohort_preflight_amendment: Before any P&L score, the backward-2023 frozen prediction file was found to contain twenty stocks while 2025 additionally contained AXTI and OKLO. Both periods are therefore restricted to the exact common twenty-stock universe below.
overlap_and_portfolio.session_grid: ordered union of regular-session dates present in the frozen provider tapes for the fixed universe; every inactive or missing symbol/session is cash with zero return and is never dropped from the denominator
overlap_and_portfolio.capital: twenty fixed equal stock sleeves, each allocated 1/20 of capital when active and otherwise cash
overlap_and_portfolio.within_sleeve_compounding: compound sequential cash-consistent simple net trade returns as product(1 + r_net) - 1 per stock/session
overlap_and_portfolio.daily_portfolio_return: equal mean of the twenty stock-sleeve arithmetic returns
overlap_and_portfolio.leave_one_stock_out: remove one frozen symbol, keep all thresholds and signals unchanged, and re-average the remaining fixed nineteen sleeves

pnl.gross_trade_return: direction * (exit_price / entry_price - 1), using a fully collateralized simple long/short sleeve convention
pnl.cost_interpretation: sensitivity assumption only; provider OHLC has no executable bid/ask spread
excluded_friction: exchange fees beyond the cost grid
latency beyond next-bar or stop fill rules

uncertainty.block_construction: non-circular overlapping contiguous five-session blocks sampled with replacement, truncated to the ordered full session-grid length
uncertainty.paired_comparison: form the aligned daily difference first so each bootstrap draw uses identical session blocks

metrics.annualization: geometric cumulative return raised to 252 divided by full session-grid count
metrics.annualized_volatility: sample standard deviation of full-grid daily returns times sqrt(252)
metrics.descriptive_sharpe: full-grid mean daily return divided by sample daily standard deviation times sqrt(252), with zero reference rate
metrics.maximum_drawdown: minimum compounded-equity divided by prior running maximum minus one, including initial equity one
metrics.profit_factor_edge_case: positive gross sum divided by absolute negative gross sum; infinity only when positive returns exist and no negative return exists; undefined when no filled trade
metrics.win_definition: strict net return > 0; ties are not wins
metrics.exposure: filled holding bars divided by 78 times fixed sleeve count times full session-grid count

predeclared_decision.failure_interpretation: No P&L support for translating the retained movement forecast with this fixed stock-only breakout rule.
predeclared_decision.pass_interpretation: Development/backward-portability P&L hypothesis only; a separately frozen genuinely prospective test remains mandatory.
